messages:
Charlie: ap-south-1 GPU fleet is seeing repeated kernel panics across several AZs, ~60% of inference pods degraded. Queues rising. We need to start shifting traffic out now. cc @Priya @Sam :rotating_light:
Priya: on it. quick numbers? how much healthy capacity remains?
Charlie: ~35% healthy capacity left. Queue growth ~2k requests/min and climbing. If we do an immediate full failover we risk huge egress + cold KV storms.
Sam: agree — suggest a weight-smoothing approach on the global router rather than instant drain. Move 10-15% every 90s to eu/na, keep affinity behavior to avoid mass session churn.
Theo: note: cookie-affinity at the GLB will preserve sessions but if backends in ap-south continue to 5xx it could keep routing to dead nodes unless health-fallback is enabled.
Priya: GLB supports cookie + backend health fallback. I'll enable `fail_on_5xx=true` so affinity gets dropped on unhealthy responses.
Charlie: plan sketch: gradual weight smoothing + small burst capacity in eu-west + prefix-KV prefetch for hot keys. I'll create the router change command now.
Charlie: `redwoodctl router update --policy smoothing --interval 90s --weights ap-south-1:0.25,eu-west-1:0.45,na-west-1:0.30 --ttl 30`
devops-bot: action queued: router policy update requested by Charlie (id: rp-1869004321).
Sam: monitoring checklist: per-region QPS, per-region error-rate, KV hit-rate, tail latency, cross-region egress. Alert thresholds: ap-south error-rate > 5% or total egress > 10TB/24h.
Maya: can we avoid spinning full 200 GPUs immediately? cost will spike. Maybe spin 100 first and evaluate. Also we should pre-warm the most active model shards.
Priya: cost estimate: 100 GPUs burst ~ $14k/day. 200 GPUs ~ $28k/day. Recommend 100 initial, with autoscale trigger at sustained QPS. I'll set autoscale to +100 now.
Sam: also enable prefix-KV prefetch for top 20k keys to reduce cold-start hits. That should blunt initial latency spikes.
Priya: enabling prefix prefetch for top-20k keys now.
devops-bot: router policy update started: smoothing rollout in progress (step interval 90s).
Maya: seeing initial metrics: ap-south QPS down 12%, KV hit-rate dipped 8%, cross-region egress +1.2TB so far. Latency is stable.
Charlie: good. keep smoothing. if ap-south error-rate > 8% then execute emergency ramp: set ap-south weight to 0.1 within 15 minutes and move remainder to eu-west.
Priya: acknowledged. setting automated escalation rule.
oncall-sre: I'm on the watch rotation and monitoring dashboards. Will shout if thresholds hit. :mag:
devops-bot: router policy update applied (rp-1869004321) — smoothing in progress.
Sam: small note — watch cookie-affinity skew. We should run a short job to evaluate sticky sessions still landing on ap-south unhealthy hosts; if so flip to IP-hash fallback.
Theo: I'll run the affinity audit script: `scripts/audit_affinity.sh --region ap-south-1 --window 5m` and report back.
Theo: audit results: ~3.4% of sticky sessions still pinned to degraded nodes, but health-fallback kicked in for most. Recommend flip affinity fallback to `ip-hash` for new sessions to avoid more pins.
Priya: switching fallback to `ip-hash` for new sessions now.
Charlie: status summary: smoothing moving traffic away, prefix prefetch live, +100 GPU burst spun in eu-west, monitoring set, escalation rule in place. Cost will rise modestly, but avoids mass cold-failover.
Maya: +1. we'll leave this thread open for handover to post-incident notes.
Charlie: thanks everyone — keep updates short here. If we hit the escalation condition we'll open an incident postmortem ticket.
